verdicts.reason: Both are essentially the same failed layout. The photo is shrunk to a thumbnail and pushed against the right edge, and the pink corner triangles are scaled up until they cover the model. The label order is scrambled to Photography/LomoArt/Fashion, so the LomoArt brand name is no longer on top. Huge black dead zones fill the rest of the tall canvas. A is very slightly better balanced from top to bottom. B sits higher and leaves a bigger empty area at the bottom, but the difference is marginal.
